profile.headline: AI Product & Technical Lead | Voice & Agentic AI | Product Strategy, Prototyping & Behavioral Quality
profile.jobTitle: Project and Development Lead, Ramona AI Project
profile.summary:
I specialize in AI context engineering, software development, and strategic project management. Currently, as Project and Development Lead at the Shinzen Young Foundation, I focus on designing advanced voice-based AI systems to create highly personalized mindfulness training. Dedicated to integrating domain expertise into AI, I aim to create tech solutions that foster well-being and resilience.  

At Shinzen Young Foundation, I lead the development of Ramona AI, a cutting-edge mindfulness coach powered by domain-specific LLM training and neuroscience principles. My role combines project leadership, context engineering, and software development with a deep understanding of Shinzen Young's Unified Mindfulness system, enabling the creation of tailored, impactful user interactions. Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams has been crucial in refining Ramona's ability to provide meaningful and transformative experiences for users.

positions.title: Project and Development Lead, Ramona AI Project
positions.description: Ramona is an advanced voice-based AI happiness coach trained on Shinzen Young's 50+ years as a master meditation teacher and neuroscience research consultant. It learns about your life and tailors a mindfulness training program to fit your needs, challenges and goals. I am the Project Lead, and also the Development Lead.  I wrote much of Ramona's code, and, having been trained as a teacher in Shinzen Young's Unified Mindfulness system, also context engineering that imbues Ramona with Shinzen's wisdom.  Through this multi-year process I have learned *a lot* about how to train LLMS on specific domain knowledge and how to teach them to reliably execute complex interactions with users.
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging Code · Node.js · Software Testing · Strategic Vision · Prompt Engineering · Context Management · Software Project Management · SQL · Front-End Development · Large Language Models (LLM) · JavaScript · Full-Stack Development · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: Debugging Code · Node.js · Software Testing · React.js · SQL · Front-End Development · JavaScript · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Documentary Filmmaker
positions.description:
Wrote, directed, shot and edited my own documentary projects.

The principal work during this time period was "Pink Boy", a multiple award-winning documentary short about a gender creative boy growing up in conservative, rural Florida.  http://pinkboyfilm.com/

Pink Boy premiered at Sheffield Doc/Fest in the United Kingdom and went on to win over nine awards including:

- Best Documentary, Palm Springs Shortfest
- Best Short, DOC NYC, Oscar-qualifying
- 2017 Webby Award, Documentary Film: Individual Episode, People's Voice
- Audience Award for Best Short, Nantucket Film Festival

The film was distributed on these platforms:

- A broadcast on the POV program on PBS
- A feature article including the film on VanityFair.com
- Features on ShortOfTheWeek.com and Topic.com

positions.title: Principal Product Manager and Developer
positions.description:
- Helped introduce program management discipline to FiftyThree, introduced new workflows for design, development, testing and feedback
- Helped drive Pencil stylus software, including handwriting recognition and the development of an SDK, which was supported by over 15 partners.
- Developed and landed partnership deals with Adobe and Microsoft to support Pencil in their apps.
- Drove multiple releases of Paper app
- Performed customer research, synthesized needs and helped layout vision for future versions of Paper and of Paste, the online presentation tool
- Helped conceive, design and prototype the automatic layout engine in Paste
- Jumped in to program many of the automatic layout engine features in Paste
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging Code · Node.js · Software Testing · React.js · SQL · Front-End Development · JavaScript · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Group Program Manager - Visio
positions.description:
Led the team that developed two versions of Visio, with a focus on data-driven graphics and moving to cloud-based offerings. Responsible for overall vision, schedule, and feature set for two versions of Visio. Managed entire Visio program management team and project managed Visio releases.


- Integrated dynamic data visualization into Visio diagrams
- Created cloud version of Visio to serve dynamic data-driven graphics and facilitate document workflows
- Streamlined workflow of Visio to improve ease of use and enable rapid flowchart creation

positions.title: Lead Program Manager - Shared Graphics Services
positions.description:
Led a team that developed shared graphics components integrated into Microsoft Office products. 

- Extensive customer research on creative and graphics workflows in Office products to inform major Office 2007 update.
- Shipped the first 3D graphics engine into PowerPoint
- Developed modern styles/templates/fonts platform integrated into the core Office Products
- Helped create SmartArt dynamic graphics creation tool - generating graphics from bulleted lists or other text

positions.title: Lead Program Manager - InfoPath
positions.description:
Lead UI team for InfoPath, a Microsoft Office XML forms workflow tool

- Lead design and program management team to develop complete forms workflow
- Developed streamlined UI for both authoring and filling out the first XML-based forms tool
- Helped coordinate forms workflow efforts across multiple Microsoft groups

positions.title: Senior Program Manager
positions.description:
Served as primary UI program manager for an early, cloud-based Office documents editor (word processor, spreadsheet, forms).

- Developed early web-based document workflow with rich editing experiences
- Drove creation of a new, context based dynamic UI model (context blocks)
- Received several software user interface patents for work

positions.title: Program Manager - Internet Explorer
positions.description:
Helped design and develop components of Internet Explorer 4.0, which featured a completely new HTML rendering and editing engine, Trident, and introduced Dynamic HTML (AJAX) to the world.

- Worked on core HTML rendering areas including tables and forms
- Helped conceptualize Dynamic HTML use cases and demonstrations (including first Dynamic HTML demonstration to Bill Gates)
- Helped drive design of some UI components for IE 4
